title: Remake under new rules
statement: When a rule changes, remake what was made under the old rule instead of serving it.
detail:
Each block's key includes the maker's version and its kind's version, so a changed prompt or check makes the block
again instead of serving the old one (`g9/transformer/src/blocks.js`); the render and playtest routes take a block only
under the key today's rules make (`g9/transformer/src/server.js`, `g9/transformer/test/server.test.mjs`).
